1.e4 Nf6 2.e5 Nd5 3.d4 d6 4.Nf3 g6 5.Bc4.strategy: Keeps the bishop instead of allowing a trade on c4. From b3 it stays on the diagonal to f7, so Black has to watch that square throughout, while White keeps its space and the initiative on the kingside.

Completes the fianchetto: the bishop attacks e5 along the long diagonal, challenging White's whole pawn centre, and Black is ready to castle. The cost is that White's pieces aim at f7 and the kingside, so Black has to hold that side together.
